title: Watchdog rules police justified in shooting death
article: Thunder Bay police have been cleared after shooting a man to death at a strip mall in October.
Ontario's police watchdog, the Special Investigations Unit, said an officer was legally justified in shooting Michael Kolisnyk after he pointed a pellet gun at police.
Mr. Kolisnyk was shot after he refused to stop for police, the SIU said. When officers caught up with him, he was seen pointing a pistol at a passenger while driving.
The SIU said he rammed police cruisers with his vehicle and pointed the gun at police. The the weapon turned out to be a pellet gun. CP
